title: 第17章 锻人第18章 离别
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 李牧火的脑子里仿佛塞满了各种感悟，这种玄之又玄的感悟，让他直接昏了过去。
“咚咚咚~”
“师兄，吃饭了。”
伴随着敲门声，钱朵朵的声音传来。
李牧火缓缓睁开了眼睛，哪怕此刻他依旧觉得脑袋有点儿昏沉。
“来了，我这就来。”
李牧火揉了揉脑袋，这种纯粹感悟方面的推演晋升，对脑力的需求似乎极高。
略微平复了一下，李牧火这才推门而出。
“今天怎么这么晚，可不像你的作风。”
就看见钱朵朵正好奇地打量着自己，似有疑惑。
李牧火自然也看向了钱朵朵，可这一看不要紧，李牧火连忙揉了揉眼睛，只觉自己出现了幻觉。
他的眼中，竟能看见钱朵朵体内灵气的走势，看见经络骨骼的强弱，看见大脉跳动的频率，看见其体内驳杂的杂质，看见五脏散发的氤氲光气，似乎他能看见了人体每一寸的复杂构成。
他看见了太多东西，已经没法一一指出，这些东西呈现青红等各色光影呈现，使得他看着钱朵朵就像是看见了一个被完全剖开的凌乱发光体。
这种体验太恐怖了，若以后自己看见其他人都是这样，他感觉自己还不如瞎了算了。
等他再睁眼看向钱朵朵，这才确认自己看见的不是幻觉。
“师兄，你怎么了？我看你的脸色似乎很难看。”
钱朵朵见李牧火神情不对，当即关切问道。
“没什么，就是昨夜修炼时好像出了点岔子，以至于气血不畅，有点头晕。”
“你扶着门别动，我去叫师父。”
钱朵朵当即神色一紧，还不等李牧火有所反应，她便已经连忙往师父的院子跑去。
李牧火定了定神，想来这定是太乙炼瑕经的特殊能力，应该不至于自己以后都得这么去看世界吧？。
当即，他循着脑海里的记忆开始回顾，很快便发现了这个能力的启用关键。
“原来如此，这竟是一种精神层面的力量。”
很快，随着李牧火精神力一收，那种昏沉感顿时敛去了几分。
吴道来得很快，毕竟炼器坊就这么大，其实钱朵朵还没跑到吴道的院子，他便已经推门走了出来。
只不过，此刻他们在李牧火眼里已经变得正常，这让他意识到，太乙炼瑕经是一门以精神控制运转的其特功法。
待来到李牧火身边，吴道皱眉道：“可感觉身体有哪些不适？”
李牧火连忙道：“禀师父，就是昨晚练铁骨功的时候，突然感觉身体发胀，而后还会有随之而来的酸疼，但现在已经好多了。”
吴道伸手捏了捏李牧火的肩膀，并往其体内注入了一股灵气。他自然发现不了什么，只能凭着经验分析道：“应该是铁骨功的级别太低，无法支撑你进一步炼体修行所致。你今日且先休息，待缓过来后，为师教你新的炼体功法。”
“谢师父。”
装都装了，李牧火知道今天是没法炼器了，索性便休息一天。
直至午时，那种昏沉感才彻底消失，诸般感悟也终于全部领会，李牧火这才缓了过来。
晚上。
钱朵朵哼着小曲儿，在膳房忙碌着。
李牧火以过来帮忙的名义，再次施展了太乙炼瑕经，那种奇异的感觉再度袭来。
不过和早上不同，现在李牧火不再昏沉，思绪也足够清晰。
随意扫了眼膳房环境，李牧火发现房梁歪了一些，桌腿有多处不平与龟裂，灶台内里有隐裂，锅具底部比锅身薄了些许。
似乎，只要他视野扫到的地方，都能看出大大小小各种问题。
这些问题都不大，但都是瑕疵，平时根本没人会注意。
但现在，李牧火注意到了，他每看到一处瑕疵，都能生出数种解决办法，哪怕有些办法可能很粗陋，但只要能起到作用，谁又能说不是好办法？
最后，李牧火将目光落在了正在忙碌的钱朵朵身上。
循着太乙炼瑕经的能力，李牧火开始逐步隐去钱朵朵身上那些杂而多的普通瑕疵，最终他发现了钱朵朵身上竟有多达近百处暗红色的瑕疵。
这种颜色和清明的淡青色给人的感觉完全不同，一眼便知这些都是重大瑕疵。
而这些瑕疵中，有半数都是来自先天经络的问题，还有血液本身太过驳杂，骨骼整体强度不足，以及脏腑间五色光晕黯淡等问题。
content_en:
Li Muhuo's mind seemed to be filled with all kinds of insights. Such profound and profound insights made him faint.
"Dong dong dong~"
"Senior brother, it's time to eat."
Along with the knock on the door, Qian Duoduo's voice came.
Li Muhuo slowly opened his eyes, even at this moment he still felt a little dizzy.
"Here it comes, I'll come right away."
Li Muhuo rubbed his head. This kind of promotion through purely perceptual reasoning seemed to require extremely high levels of brain power.
After calming down for a while, Li Muhuo pushed the door open and walked out.
"Why are you so late today? It's not like your style."
He saw Qian Duoduo looking at him curiously, as if he was confused.
Li Muhuo naturally looked at Qian Duoduo, but it didn't matter. Li Muhuo quickly rubbed his eyes and felt that he was hallucinating.
In his eyes, he could actually see the trend of spiritual energy in Qian Duoduo's body, the strength of his meridians and bones, the beating frequency of his major pulses, the various impurities in his body, and the dense light emitting from his five internal organs. It seemed that he could see the complex composition of every inch of the human body.
He saw so many things that he couldn't point them out one by one. These things presented various colors of light and shadow, such as green and red, making him look at Qian Duoduo as if he were seeing a messy luminous body that had been completely cut open.
This experience was so terrifying. If he saw other people like this in the future, he felt that he might as well just go blind.
When he opened his eyes and looked at Qian Duoduo again, he confirmed that what he saw was not an illusion.
"Senior brother, what's wrong with you? I see that your face looks ugly."
When Qian Duoduo saw that Li Muhuo looked strange, he immediately asked with concern.
"It's nothing, it's just that something went wrong during last night's practice, which caused my blood and energy to become sluggish and I felt a little dizzy."
"Hold the door and don't move. I'll call Master."
Qian Duoduo's expression immediately tightened, and before Li Muhuo could react, she hurriedly ran to the master's yard.
Li Muhuo calmed down, thinking that this must be Taiyi's special ability of refining flaws. He shouldn't have to see the world like this in the future, right? .
Immediately, he began to review according to the memory in his mind, and soon discovered the key to enabling this ability.
"So it turns out that this is a kind of spiritual power."
Soon, as Li Muhuo's mental energy retreated, the feeling of drowsiness subsided a bit.
Wu Dao came very quickly. After all, the weapon refining workshop was so big. In fact, before Qian Duoduo even ran to Wu Dao's yard, he had already opened the door and walked out.
However, at this moment, they had become normal in Li Muhuo's eyes, which made him realize that the Taiyi Refining Imperfections Sutra was a special skill that operated under mental control.
When he came to Li Muhuo, Wu Dao frowned and said, "Do you feel any discomfort in your body?"
Li Muhuo said quickly: "Master, when I was practicing Iron Bone Kung Fu last night, my body suddenly felt swollen, and there would be accompanying soreness, but I'm much better now."
Wu Dao reached out and pinched Li Muhuo's shoulder, and injected a stream of spiritual energy into his body. Naturally, he couldn't find anything. He could only analyze based on experience: "It should be that the level of Iron Bone Kung Fu is too low to support your further body training. You will rest today. After you recover, I will teach you new body training techniques."
"Thank you, Master."
After all the pretense, Li Muhuo knew that he would not be able to refine weapons today, so he simply took a day off.
It wasn't until noon that the drowsiness completely disappeared, and all the insights were finally understood, and Li Muhuo calmed down.
night.
Qian Duoduo hummed a little tune and was busy in the dining room.
In the name of coming to help, Li Muhuo used the Taiyi Refining Imperfections Sutra again, and that strange feeling came over him again.
But unlike in the morning, Li Muhuo was no longer groggy now, and his thoughts were clear enough.
Taking a casual look at the dining room, Li Muhuo found that the beams were a little crooked, the table legs had many unevenness and cracks, there were cracks inside the stove, and the bottom of the pot was a little thinner than the body.
It seemed that wherever he looked, he could see problems of all sizes.
These problems are not major, but they are flaws that no one would notice at ordinary times.
But now, Li Muhuo has noticed that every time he sees a flaw, he can come up with several solutions. Even if some of the solutions may be crude, as long as they can work, who can say that it is not a good solution?
Finally, Li Muhuo turned his attention to Qian Duoduo who was busy.
Following Taiyi's ability to refine the flaws, Li Muhuo began to gradually hide the numerous ordinary flaws on Qian Duoduo's body. Finally, he discovered that Qian Duoduo had nearly a hundred dark red flaws on his body.
This color gives people a completely different feel from the clear light cyan, and you can tell at a glance that these are major flaws.
Half of these defects are caused by problems with the congenital meridians, as well as problems such as the blood itself being too complex, the overall strength of the bones being insufficient, and the five-color halos between the organs being dim.
title_en: Chapter 17 Forging a Man Chapter 18 Farewell
